Cup Lids & Sealing Films — Match by Model and Rim Profile

Lids and sealing films should be selected alongside the exact cup model. Use the fit information as a planning reference, not as a universal compatibility guarantee.

Key Features

  • Review flat, dome, sipper and specialty lid styles
  • Match lid and film to the selected cup model
  • Check rim profile rather than caliber alone
  • Request physical cup-and-lid samples
  • Confirm PP/PET film material for the selected cup
  • Confirm artwork, MOQ and carton configuration per item

Quick Facts for Sourcing

  • • Order quantity: Confirm the minimum for your selected model and artwork.
  • • Documents: Request material and food-contact reports for your destination market.
  • • Fit: Confirm the cup, lid and sealing material with a physical sample.
  • • Specifications: Use the series table below as a starting point; request final drawings.

Nominal Caliber Is Only the Starting Point

The supplied catalogs show many cup shapes at similar nominal calibers. A reliable fit requires the actual rim profile, lid geometry, film material and machine tooling to be checked together. Exact lid weights, film specifications, printing, MOQ and compatibility are pending factory confirmation where not listed.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I confirm which lid fits my cup?

Send the exact cup model or drawing, confirm the nominal rim, and test the cup and lid together. Final fit should not be inferred from the nominal diameter alone.

Are exact film specifications available in the latest cup catalogs?

The supplied cup catalogs do not provide a complete film specification sheet. Confirm film material, thickness, printing, sealing temperature and machine setup with the factory.

Can sealing film be custom printed?

Printing availability, MOQ and artwork requirements are pending factory confirmation for the selected film and cup combination.
